courses.overview: 跨單元連結與比較練習

related.title: Laura Maersk 甲醇貨櫃船
related.why: 比較兩個系統的負載、能源或資料介面，列出不可直接沿用的邊界條件。
related.whyEn: Compare load, energy or data interfaces and identify boundary conditions that cannot be transferred.
related.difference: 船體尺度、載荷條件、海況及驗證目的必須分別設定。
related.differenceEn: Vessel scale, load conditions, sea state and verification purpose require separate definitions.
practice: 各選一個教學算例，記下輸入、輸出與單位。
對照兩課的系統邊界，說明哪些假設不能沿用。
改變一個輸入，提出量測與失效判據來核對結果。
practiceEn: Choose one worked example from each course and record inputs, outputs and units.
Compare system boundaries and identify assumptions that cannot transfer.
Change one input and propose measurements and failure criteria to check the result.

history.title: Q-Max 液化天然氣船
history.text: 此案例作為工程問題的入口；以所列原始機構資料核對背景。本課數值與操作任務為原創教學假設，沒有宣稱複製同名船舶或設施的實測性能。
history.textEn: This case is an entry to engineering questions; verify background with the originating institutions linked here. Numbers and tasks are original teaching assumptions and do not reproduce measured named-vessel or facility performance.

courses.connection: 以Q-Max液化天然氣船級名稱作低溫大型運輸案例，重點在貨物能量和船舶能量分開核算；不把教學潛熱或效率視為同名船型實際值。 各單元為獨立縮尺練習，串接的是驗證流程，不是同一實船的校準數位分身。
courses.connectionEn: Use the Q-Max class as a large cryogenic-transport case, accounting separately for cargo energy and vessel energy without treating assumed latent heat or efficiency as class specifications. Units are independent scaled exercises connected by a verification workflow, not a calibrated digital twin of one vessel.
